findings.title: Symlinked directories evade the E01 fresh-output inventory
findings.scenario: A generated namespace directory such as runroot/lapsprd/lco is a symlink to a directory containing a stale product. pathlib rglob does not recurse through the symlink, and inventory skips the directory because is_file() is false.
findings.consequence: assert_fresh_generated_namespace accepts a runroot with preexisting generated output; a producer following that directory can access or write outside the intended runroot.
findings.probe: Reproduced under /var/tmp/cloud_bal_audit12_e01.7nO7e1: inventory returned {}, and the freshness gate accepted the stale lco hidden under a symlinked directory.
findings.existing_test: tests/test_e01_completion_gate.py:126-134 tests only a regular stale product; no symlink-directory test.
findings.next_check: Reject symlink directories in a no-follow walk and add a test for a nested stale product behind lapsprd/lco symlink.
findings.coverage: Targeted E01 tests passed; additional safe failure probe reproduced bypass.

findings.title: E01 executable hash check returns no launch-bound object
findings.scenario: bind_producer_executable hashes a pathname and returns the digest. A later path-based exec can run replacement bytes after the check. Repository search found no E01 orchestration caller that binds the checked object through exec.
findings.consequence: The helper proves a file was present with expected bytes at check time but does not yet prove the stage executed those bytes.
findings.existing_test: tests/test_e01_completion_gate.py:136-150 covers missing and mismatched producer paths, not path replacement before exec.
findings.next_check: Integrate E01 launch with sealed memfd binding and a launch receipt tied to the actual stage, or retain E01 as NOT_RUN until orchestration exists.
findings.coverage: Static review and repository caller search only; no production E01 launch was run.
